Claim: A dropped authority socket now surfaces a visible disconnected state, but nothing attempts to reconnect, so recovery still requires the player to reload the page manually.

Failure scenario: A player loses connectivity for a few seconds mid-session, which a laptop suspend or a wifi handover makes routine; the client correctly freezes and shows a disconnected state rather than silently no-oping, but never retries, so the player must notice the message and reload to continue playing even though the network recovered on its own.

Proposed fix: Add a bounded reconnect with backoff to WorldAuthorityClient, re-joining the current world and resynchronising state on success, and fall back to the visible disconnected state only after the attempts are exhausted.

Verification: Kill the WebSocket from the console, confirm the client reconnects on its own within a few seconds and the player can move again without a page reload.
